Writes the sections of RiverSectionsExtractor as a geometry file for the GIS import of HEC-RAS.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Hecras, Raster, Vector, Hydraulic<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.HecrasInputBuilder`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRiverPoints` | vector file |  |  | The points of the river between the sections, from RiverSectionsExtractor. |
| `inSections` | vector file |  |  | The section lines, from RiverSectionsExtractor. |
| `inSectionPoints` | vector file |  |  | The points of the sections, with their elevation, from RiverSectionsExtractor. |
| `pTitle` | String |  | `DEFAULTID` | The id of the river in HEC-RAS. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outHecras` | output file |  | The output file for HEC-RAS (.sdf). |
